id: title:abhischekt:flag orgs created by posthog com users as excluded from crm

review.posthog_relevance: Adds CRM exclusion checks to the organization creation workflow, preventing internal organization emails from being added to CRM records.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the implementation and testing of CRM exclusion checks. P1.F1.H2 shows the invocation of the exclusion function, and P1.F2.H1 shows the corresponding test. P1.F1.H1 is the supporting import. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned as 1 because the implementation and tests are present, but the tier is not 3 because the broader systemic impact or critical path dependency is not demonstrated; the chunk does not show the full implementation of the underlying CRM exclusion function or the constant definition, and the chunk does not demonstrate a broader systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the CRM exclusion check, the definition of the POSTHOG_INTERNAL_EMAIL_SUFFIX constant, or the actual invocation of the new function. It only shows the import and the test assertions. Therefore, while the behavior and the PostHog connection are clear, the tier cannot be assigned without seeing the actual implementation and the point,

observations.behavior: Adds import of the CRM exclusion function.
observations.posthog_connection: This import is required to use the CRM exclusion function, which is not shown in this chunk.

observations.behavior: Calls the CRM exclusion function after creating an organization.
observations.posthog_connection: This call marks an organization as CRM-excluded, but the implementation and the constant used are not shown.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for CRM exclusion, including the expected properties.
observations.posthog_connection: This test checks that the CRM exclusion property is set, but the implementation and the constant are not shown.
